question: Should OpenClaw remove these released root bundled skills now and ship Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin in the same change?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but only maintainers can accept the compatibility contract, release timing, official package trust, and support burden created by this broad removal.

options.title: Land with migration and trust proof
options.body: Add doctor migration and upgrade coverage, verify replacement package availability, and resolve exact-head dependency and native-artifact approval before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the coherent Sherpa and ClawHub-only install work into a narrower PR while deferring the broad starter-set removal.

options.title: Accept the breaking trim
options.body: Intentionally ship the manual migration burden with explicit release ownership and support documentation.

recommendation.title: Land with migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Add doctor migration and upgrade coverage, verify replacement package availability, and resolve exact-head dependency and native-artifact approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged precursor slices, is assigned here, and has defined the remaining product boundary in the discussion.
